subject: 970 Fellsway Chapter 40B Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board resumed hearings on a 289-unit Chapter 40B development at 970 Fellsway and authorized peer review consultants, while granting a special permit for 417 Salem Street and continuing petitions for 290 Salem Street and 44 Terrace Road.

items.title: 290 Salem Street
items.summary: Continued to January 11, 2024, at the applicant's request.

items.title: 970 Fellsway Chapter 40B Comprehensive Permit
items.summary: Heard an introductory presentation for a 289-unit multifamily development, took public comment, authorized hiring peer review consultants for design, engineering, and traffic, and continued the hearing to January 11, 2024.

items.title: 44 Terrace Road
items.summary: Continued the special permit petition to January 11, 2024, after substantial neighborhood opposition to the proposed size, height, and location of the reconstructed single-family home.

items.title: 417 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to enclose an existing porch and alter a nonconforming mixed-use building, with board member Jamie recused.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Deferred approval of meeting minutes to the January meeting and discussed website link corrections and meeting scheduling logistics.
